goals.statement: 작은 회사의 업무비 청구부터 승인과 지급 상태 관리까지 하나의 웹앱에서 추적 가능하게 한다.

requirements.mobile_policy: Responsive current iOS Safari/Android Chrome; camera capture or file selection for JPG/PNG/PDF under identical upload/scan/recovery rules; no native/offline.
requirements.manager_reassignment_notification: Related employee receives email+in-app after committed manager reassignment; delivery follows common retries and never rolls back reassignment.
requirements.category_seed_policy: Select one active category from nine seeded stable IDs; submission is blocked when no category is active; submitted revision retains ID/name snapshot.
requirements.timeline_allowlist_policy: Employee-facing timeline exposes only approved business fields and masked external reference; all internal diagnostics/identifiers and legal/Admin-only notes are hidden.
requirements.list_policy: Role-scoped claim search/filter/sort is available; Employee has no CSV export.
requirements.integration_boundary: Employee uses invitation-email app-native account; no SSO, payroll, accounting, or bank integration in v1; email delivery service is external dependency.
requirements.download_access_policy: 5-minute user/file-scoped access, reusable for range/retry, with latest login/role/relationship/file authorization per request and audited issue/success/denial; raw token never logged.
requirements.tax_amount_policy: Claim amount is the receipt's final paid total only; foreign currency uses original-currency final total for conversion; no VAT split or deductibility fields in v1.
requirements.admin_dependency: Employee account, roles, direct manager, category availability, and claim holds are managed through the versioned audited Admin console.
requirements.revision_visibility_policy: Employee can read all revisions/reviews of own claim; attachment downloads remain least-privilege and short-lived; internal audit fields are masked by timeline policy.
requirements.global_concurrency_policy: Every mutation requires expected version and idempotency key; stale writes are all-or-nothing rejected with latest state and changed fields while browser input is preserved.
requirements.revision_loop_policy: Unlimited changes-requested resubmissions until final rejection or employee withdrawal; all revision/review history retained; only latest revision is actionable.
requirements.invitation_revocation_policy: Admin revocation of an unaccepted invitation immediately invalidates it with mandatory reason and audit; concurrent acceptance is resolved by first atomic commit.
requirements.invitation_policy: Invitation expires after 7 days; successful reissue invalidates prior unused link; only invited email can activate; active/deactivated accounts gain no authority; lifecycle is audited.
requirements.revocation_policy: Immediate sessions/tokens invalidation; next API request latest auth; rejected draft mutation preserves browser input.
requirements.expense_date_policy: Future blocks; over 90 days requires reason but submits; Asia/Seoul calendar.
requirements.draft_deletion_job: Daily 02:00 KST, eligibility recheck, failed remains undeleted, idempotent next-run retry, audited result.
requirements.autosave_retry_policy: 1/2/4/8/16-second retries; latest generation wins; stale retries cancel; then manual retry only.
requirements.autosave_policy: 2-second debounce plus blur/file-link immediate save with visible state, preserved input, retries, and unsaved-navigation warning.
requirements.draft_retention_policy: 90 days after last saved actual change, warning at 7 days before, view does not extend, deletion audited.
requirements.draft_recovery_policy: Server draft survives re-login; failed bytes are discarded; scan retries 30s/2m then blocks submit while preserving draft.
requirements.notification_retry_policy: 1m, 10m, 60m automatic retries; permanent failure warning; one Admin manual retry.
requirements.notification_policy: Employee lifecycle notifications use email and in-app delivery records separate from business state.
requirements.statement: 직원은 필수 비용 정보와 영수증을 포함한 업무비 청구를 작성해 자신의 고정 직속 매니저에게 제출할 수 있다. 외화 비용은 원통화 정보, 적용 환율, 청구 KRW 환산액과 허용된 환율 증빙을 함께 기록한다. 수정 요청된 청구는 동일 청구의 새 revision으로 수정·재제출할 수 있고 매니저 미지정 시 제출할 수 없다.

requirements.mobile_policy: Core review and decision actions work responsively on current iOS Safari and Android Chrome; no native/offline.
requirements.manager_reassignment_notification: Previous and new managers receive email+in-app after committed reassignment; delivery follows common retries and never rolls back reassignment.
requirements.timeline_allowlist_policy: Manager-facing timeline exposes only approved business fields; internal diagnostics/identifiers and legal/Admin-only notes are hidden.
requirements.list_policy: Role/relationship-scoped claim search/filter/sort is available; Manager has no CSV export.
requirements.integration_boundary: Manager uses invitation-email app-native account; no SSO or external approval-system integration in v1.
requirements.approval_delay_policy: From elapsed day 3 after submission/resubmission, assigned manager gets one daily email+in-app reminder until decision, withdrawal, or reassignment; no automatic delegation.
requirements.download_access_policy: 5-minute user/file-scoped access reauthorizes every request; loss of manager relationship immediately denies even an unexpired token.
requirements.tax_amount_policy: Manager reviews the final paid total and, for foreign currency, its conversion; no separate VAT or deductibility review in v1.
requirements.admin_dependency: Manager account/roles, relationships, exceptional reassignment, and related audit are managed through the versioned audited Admin console.
requirements.revision_visibility_policy: A manager with current processing authority can read all revisions/reviews of the in-scope claim; loss of authority immediately revokes all historical access.
requirements.global_concurrency_policy: Every review mutation validates expected version; stale actions mutate nothing and receive latest state plus changed fields; duplicate idempotency keys replay original result.
requirements.revision_loop_policy: Review actions are revision-pinned; a newer submitted revision makes unfinished actions against an older revision stale and non-mutating.
requirements.invitation_revocation_policy: Manager account activation cannot complete from an invitation that an Admin revocation committed first.
requirements.invitation_policy: Manager access requires an active invited account; invitation links never grant authority to an already active or deactivated account.
requirements.revocation_policy: Immediate server authorization on every action.
requirements.late_claim_review: Highlight late day count and employee reason.
requirements.notification_retry_policy: 1m, 10m, 60m automatic retries; permanent failure warning; one Admin manual retry.
requirements.notification_policy: Manager submission/resubmission/revocation-result notifications use both channels.
requirements.payment_hold_correction: After Scheduled, Admin-controlled Changes requested creates a new employee revision for current-manager reapproval.
requirements.statement: 직원의 고정 직속 매니저는 자신에게 제출된 업무비 청구와 외화 환산 근거를 검토해 승인, 수정 요청, 최종 반려 중 하나로 처리할 수 있다.

requirements.mobile_policy: Core payment review/state transitions work responsively on current iOS Safari and Android Chrome; bulk CSV is desktop-recommended.
requirements.timeline_allowlist_policy: Finance-facing timeline exposes only approved business fields and masked external reference; internal diagnostics/identifiers and legal/Admin-only notes are hidden.
requirements.list_policy: Finance can search/filter/sort in current scope and export current filtered results up to 10,000 rows after latest authorization check.
requirements.integration_boundary: Finance manually manages payment state and external reference; no accounting, payroll, or bank integration in v1.
requirements.download_access_policy: 5-minute user/file-scoped access reauthorizes every request; loss of Finance scope immediately denies even an unexpired token.
requirements.tax_amount_policy: Finance payment basis is the approved final paid total/KRW conversion; VAT split and deductibility are not managed in v1.
requirements.admin_dependency: Finance account/roles, exceptional reassignment, operational warnings, and related audit are managed through the versioned audited Admin console.
requirements.settlement_failure_resolution: Failed adjustments never reactivate; append-only external-execution verification routes to linked replacement, actual completion, or blocking Needs verification.
requirements.settlement_adjustment_sequence_policy: Multiple sequential adjustments allowed, exactly zero or one In progress per claim; net = original payment - completed recoveries + completed additional payments; failed/cancelled excluded.
requirements.actual_payment_date_policy: Asia/Seoul date must be between the latest valid approval leading to payment and today inclusive; entry/correction is audited.
requirements.failed_payment_retry_verification: Before rescheduling, Finance records channel, masked account, lookup period, prior reference or result, Not-paid conclusion, verifier/time, and optional evidence in an append-only claim-linked record.
requirements.revision_visibility_policy: A Finance user with current processing authority can read all revisions/reviews of the in-scope claim; loss of authority immediately revokes all historical access.
requirements.global_concurrency_policy: Every payment mutation validates expected version; stale actions mutate nothing and receive latest state plus changed fields; duplicate idempotency keys replay original result.
requirements.invitation_revocation_policy: Finance account activation cannot complete from an invitation that an Admin revocation committed first.
requirements.invitation_policy: Finance access requires an active invited account; invitation links never grant authority to an already active or deactivated account.
requirements.revocation_policy: Immediate server authorization on every action.
requirements.notification_retry_policy: 1m, 10m, 60m automatic retries; permanent failure warning; one Admin manual retry.
requirements.notification_policy: Employee payment/adjustment events and shared Finance new-approval events use both channels.
requirements.finance_owner_policy: Approved claims start in shared queue; Scheduled atomically self-assigns Finance owner; Admin can reassign with reason and audit.
requirements.overdue_policy: Highlight from next-day 00:00 KST and notify responsible Finance once daily by email and in-app until terminal/hold handling.
requirements.payment_field_policy: Scheduled date is required and not in the past; completed payment method, actual date, and company-unique external reference are required.
requirements.settlement_adjustment: Finance manages linked Recovery or Additional payment adjustments without reverting Payment completed.
requirements.payment_hold_correction: Finance may hold a Scheduled claim with reason and must record external-execution verification when applicable.
requirements.statement: 재무 담당자는 승인된 업무비 청구의 지급 상태를 지급 대기, 지급 예정, 지급 완료, 지급 실패로 수동 관리하고 외부 지급 정보를 기록할 수 있다.

requirements.mobile_policy: Core Admin review/state transitions work responsively on current iOS Safari and Android Chrome; bulk CSV is desktop-recommended.
requirements.manager_reassignment_notification: Admin sees permanent reassignment-delivery failures and may trigger the common one-time manual retry without changing committed reassignment.
requirements.category_seed_policy: Admin may rename/deactivate seeded categories without changing stable ID or historical snapshots; zero-active state blocks new claim submission.
requirements.timeline_allowlist_policy: Admin retains authorized raw audit viewing, but Admin CSV export uses the same or narrower user-safe allowlist and never exports internal diagnostics or legal/Admin-only notes.
requirements.list_policy: Admin can search/filter/sort across operational scope and export current filtered results up to 10,000 rows after latest authorization check.
requirements.integration_boundary: Admin manages invitation-email app-native accounts; no SSO configuration in v1. Export scope remains governed by UNK-022.
requirements.approval_escalation_policy: From elapsed day 7 after submission/resubmission, unresolved review appears in Admin operational warnings until decision, withdrawal, or reassignment.
requirements.statement: Admin manages invitations and revocations, accounts and multiple roles, direct managers, expense categories, legal holds, manager and Finance reassignments, full audit records, and operational warnings in dedicated web screens.
requirements.mutation_policy: Every Admin mutation validates latest version, is atomic on stale conflict, and writes append-only audit before/after provenance.

unknowns.question: 청구의 승인자를 어떤 규칙으로 정할까요?
unknowns.why: 승인 권한, 라우팅, 대기열, 알림, 감사 기록, 예외 처리 전반을 결정한다.
unknowns.evidence: 요청문에는 매니저가 승인한다고만 되어 있고 매니저 지정 방식은 없다.
options: 부서/금액 등 규칙에 따른 다단계 승인
unknowns.resolution: 직원마다 고정된 직속 매니저 1명이 승인한다. 직원은 매니저를 임의 변경하거나 승인자를 선택할 수 없다. 매니저 미지정 시 제출을 차단하고 관리자 문의를 안내한다.
unknowns.source: 사용자 답변: 1번 및 상세 정책, 2026-08-21

unknowns.question: 사용자 계정은 누가 만들고 회사 소속과 역할을 어떻게 부여하나요?
unknowns.resolution: 관리자가 이메일로 초대하고 직원·매니저·재무·관리자 역할을 부여한다. 초대받은 이메일로만 계정을 활성화할 수 있고 공개 가입은 없다.
unknowns.source: 사용자 답변: 1번 및 상세 초대 정책, 2026-08-21

unknowns.question: 한 사람이 직원·매니저·재무 역할을 동시에 가질 수 있나요?
unknowns.resolution: 한 사용자가 여러 역할을 가질 수 있다. 단 자기 청구는 자기 승인할 수 없고 각 동작마다 필요한 역할과 대상과의 관계를 서버에서 검사한다.

unknowns.question: 매니저의 검토 결과는 승인 외에 반려와 수정 요청을 구분하나요?
unknowns.resolution: 검토 결과는 승인, 수정 요청, 최종 반려로 구분한다. 수정 요청과 최종 반려에는 매니저 코멘트가 필수다. 수정 요청된 청구는 동일 청구의 새 revision으로 수정·재제출한다. 최종 반려는 청구를 종료하며 같은 비용도 새 청구로만 다시 제출할 수 있다.
unknowns.source: 사용자 답변: 3번 및 상세 정책, 2026-08-21

unknowns.amended_resolution: Draft edit/delete and employee withdrawal semantics remain. The prior no-revocation rule is replaced: before Scheduled, the approving manager may revoke their own approval with a mandatory reason, returning the same revision to Submitted; at or after Scheduled revocation is forbidden.
unknowns.question: 직원은 제출 전·후·반려 후 각각 언제 청구를 수정하거나 취소할 수 있나요?
unknowns.resolution: 작성 중에는 직원이 수정·삭제할 수 있다. 제출 후 직접 수정은 불가하지만 매니저가 승인·수정 요청·최종 반려 중 하나를 확정하기 전까지만 철회할 수 있다. 철회는 종료 상태이며 재청구는 새 청구로 한다. 승인 확정 시 해당 revision은 잠기고 매니저도 승인을 철회할 수 없으며 재무 지급 흐름으로 이동한다.
unknowns.source: 사용자 답변: 1번 및 승인 잠금·이관 정책, 2026-08-21

unknowns.question: 청구에 필수인 항목은 무엇인가요?
unknowns.resolution: 비용 발생일, 가맹점/지급처, 금액, 통화, 비용 카테고리, 업무 목적, 영수증이 필수다. 회사 기준 통화는 KRW이며 외화 영수증은 원통화 금액·통화와 직원이 청구하는 KRW 환산액을 함께 기록한다.
unknowns.source: 사용자 답변: 1번에 통화 추가 및 외화 기록 규칙, 2026-08-21

unknowns.question: 영수증 파일 형식·크기·개수 제한과 한 청구 내 여러 영수증 허용 여부는 무엇인가요?
unknowns.resolution: 영수증은 PDF/JPG/PNG, 파일당 최대 10MB, 청구 revision당 최대 10개다. 환율 증빙은 같은 형식·크기 제한에 revision당 최대 5개다. 서버에서 실제 MIME과 확장자를 모두 검사하고 악성 파일 검사를 통과하기 전에는 다운로드할 수 없으며 실패 파일은 청구에 연결하지 않는다.
unknowns.source: 사용자 답변: 1번 및 환율 증빙·보안 검사 정책, 2026-08-21

unknowns.question: 한 청구에 여러 비용 항목을 묶을 수 있나요, 아니면 비용 1건당 청구 1건인가요?
unknowns.resolution: 청구 1건당 비용 항목 1건이다. 여러 영수증은 그 하나의 비용을 증명하는 자료이며 서로 다른 거래는 각각 별도 청구로 작성한다.
unknowns.source: 사용자 답변: 1번 및 영수증 의미, 2026-08-21

unknowns.question: 외화 청구의 KRW 환산액에 사용할 환율 출처·기준일과 환율 증빙 제출 규칙은 무엇인가요?
unknowns.resolution: 직원이 적용 환율과 KRW 환산액을 직접 입력하고 카드 명세, 은행 환전 내역, 공식 환율 페이지 캡처 또는 PDF 중 하나를 첨부한다. 매니저는 원통화 금액, 환율, 환산액, 증빙을 함께 검토하고 불일치하면 수정 요청한다. 시스템은 원통화 금액×환율과 입력 KRW액의 차이가 반올림 허용오차 안인지 검사한다.
unknowns.source: 사용자 답변: 3번 및 상세 증빙·검토·검증 규칙, 2026-08-21

unknowns.question: 비용 카테고리, 한도, 사전승인 등 회사 경비 정책을 앱에서 검증해야 하나요?
unknowns.resolution: 관리자가 활성 비용 카테고리 목록만 관리한다. v1에서는 금액 한도·사전승인·예외 승인을 자동화하지 않는다. 각 청구 revision은 제출 당시 카테고리 ID·이름 snapshot을 보존하고 사용된 카테고리를 비활성화해도 과거 기록은 유지하되 새 청구에서 선택할 수 없다.
unknowns.source: 사용자 답변: 1번 및 카테고리 snapshot·비활성화 정책, 2026-08-21

unknowns.question: 같은 영수증이나 동일 거래의 중복 청구를 어떻게 탐지·차단하나요?
unknowns.resolution: 회사 전체에서 동일 파일 해시 영수증이 활성 또는 보존 중 청구에 있으면 제출을 차단하고 기존 청구 ID는 권한 있는 사용자에게만 표시한다. 같은 직원의 비용일·가맹점·금액·통화가 일치하면 중복 의심 경고와 사유 입력을 요구한 뒤 제출을 허용하고 매니저 검토 화면에 강조한다. 최종 삭제된 자료의 해시는 중복 검사에 쓰지 않는다.
unknowns.source: 사용자 답변: 1번 및 상세 차단·경고·수명주기 정책, 2026-08-21

unknowns.resolution: If more than 90 days elapsed since expense date, late reason is mandatory but submission is allowed; manager sees highlighted late days and reason. Future expense date blocks submission. Date calculations use Asia/Seoul.
unknowns.source: User answer: option 2 with future-date and timezone rules, 2026-08-21
unknowns.question: 비용 발생 후 청구 제출 기한이 있나요?
unknowns.source: 사용자 최초 요청에서 미정

unknowns.resolution: From 3 elapsed Asia/Seoul calendar days after submission/resubmission, notify assigned manager once daily by email and in-app. From 7 elapsed days, also show Admin operational warning. No automatic delegate approval; use existing Admin reassignment. Stop on review decision, employee withdrawal, or reassignment. Existing idempotency/retry delivery policy applies.
unknowns.answer_source: User answer: option 1 with stop conditions and existing delivery policy, 2026-08-21
unknowns.question: 승인 지연 시 리마인더·에스컬레이션·대리 승인 규칙은 무엇인가요?
unknowns.source: 사용자 최초 요청에서 미정

unknowns.question: 제출 당시 매니저가 퇴사·비활성화되어 현재 revision을 처리할 수 없으면 누가 인계받고 어떻게 재라우팅하나요?
unknowns.resolution: 관리자가 처리 불가능한 진행 중 revision을 새 매니저에게 재배정한다. 이전·새 승인자, 재배정 사유, 시각을 감사 기록에 남기고 기존 검토 코멘트는 보존하며 미완료 승인 권한만 이전한다. 재배정 알림 실패는 재배정을 되돌리지 않는다.
unknowns.source: 사용자 답변: 1번 및 상세 재배정·알림 정책, 2026-08-21

unknowns.question: 지급 상태의 정확한 단계와 허용 전이는 무엇인가요?
unknowns.resolution: 지급 대기 → 지급 예정 → 지급 완료를 기본 전이로 하고 실패 시 지급 실패로 기록한다. v1은 재무 담당자가 수동 변경하며, 지급 실패에서 중복 지급 없이 지급 예정으로 재전환할 수 있다. 지급 완료에는 외부 지급 참조번호와 지급일, 지급 실패에는 사유가 필수다.
unknowns.source: 사용자 답변: 2번 및 상세 정책, 2026-08-21

unknowns.resolution: Scheduled requires a scheduled date that is today or in the future. Payment completed requires payment method, actual payment date, and a company-wide unique external reference number. decisions.decision: 각 직원에게 고정된 직속 매니저 1명을 연결하고 그 매니저만 해당 직원 청구의 승인자가 된다.
decisions.reason: 사용자가 1번 방식을 선택하고 직원의 임의 변경 및 승인자 선택을 금지했다.

decisions.decision: 매니저 검토 결과는 승인, 수정 요청, 최종 반려이며 수정 요청은 동일 청구의 새 revision으로 이어지고 최종 반려는 해당 청구를 종료한다.
decisions.reason: 사용자가 3분기 검토 결과와 revision·종료 의미를 명시했다.

decisions.decision: v1 지급 상태는 지급 대기, 지급 예정, 지급 완료, 지급 실패이며 재무 담당자가 외부 지급 결과를 근거로 수동 관리한다.
decisions.reason: 사용자가 2번 흐름과 수동 지급 운영을 명시했다.

decisions.decision: 청구 필수 필드는 비용 발생일, 가맹점/지급처, 금액, 통화, 비용 카테고리, 업무 목적, 영수증이며 기준 통화는 KRW다. 외화 비용은 원통화 금액·통화와 청구 KRW 환산액을 함께 저장한다.
decisions.reason: 사용자가 기본 필드 세트에 통화를 추가하고 외화 기록 방식을 명시했다.

decisions.decision: 외화 청구는 직원이 적용 환율과 KRW 환산액을 입력하고 허용된 환율 증빙을 첨부하며, 매니저가 네 요소를 함께 검토하고 시스템이 산식 허용오차를 검사한다.
decisions.reason: 사용자가 수동 환율 입력·증빙·검토 방식을 선택했다.

decisions.decision: 환율은 외화 1단위당 KRW, 소수점 최대 6자리로 저장하고 원통화 금액×환율을 원 단위 사사오입한 계산값과 직원 입력 KRW액의 차이를 ±1원까지 허용한다.
decisions.reason: 사용자가 1번 계산 규칙을 선택했다.

decisions.decision: 청구와 영수증은 역할·상태 기반 최소 권한으로 조회하고 다운로드도 같은 권한을 적용하며 파일 직접 접근은 재인증·권한 확인되는 짧은 수명 방식만 허용한다.
decisions.reason: 사용자가 최소 권한 1번과 파일 접근 제한을 명시했다.

decisions.decision: 계정은 관리자가 이메일로 초대하고 역할을 부여하며 초대받은 이메일로만 활성화할 수 있고 공개 가입은 제공하지 않는다.
decisions.reason: 사용자가 관리자 초대 방식 1번을 선택했다.

decisions.decision: 사용자는 복수 역할을 가질 수 있지만 자기 청구를 승인할 수 없고 모든 동작은 서버에서 역할과 대상 관계를 함께 검사한다.
decisions.reason: 사용자가 복수 역할 및 권한 충돌 방지 원칙을 명시했다.

decisions.decision: 관리자만 직원의 직속 매니저를 지정·변경하며 각 제출·재제출 revision은 그 시점의 매니저를 승인자로 고정한다. 변경 후 새 청구와 다음 재제출 revision부터 새 매니저를 적용한다.
decisions.reason: 사용자가 1번과 revision 적용 경계 및 감사 기록을 명시했다.

decisions.decision: 제출 당시 매니저가 비활성화되어 처리할 수 없으면 관리자가 진행 중 revision의 미완료 승인 권한만 새 매니저에게 재배정하고 기존 검토 기록을 보존한다.
decisions.reason: 사용자가 1번 재배정 예외와 감사·알림 실패 의미를 명시했다.

decisions.decision: 주요 청구·권한·지급·파일 행위를 revision 단위 append-only 원본 감사 기록으로 저장하고, 관리자는 원본 전체를 보며 관련 사용자는 권한에 맞게 축약·마스킹된 자기 청구 타임라인만 본다.
decisions.reason: 사용자가 2번 감사 범위와 역할별 표시를 명시했다.

decisions.decision: 지급 완료 또는 최종 반려 회계연도 기준으로 청구·첨부·감사 기록을 7년 보관하고 legal hold 예외를 적용한 뒤 자동 삭제하며 삭제 결과도 감사 기록한다.
decisions.reason: 사용자가 2번과 고정 보존 기간, legal hold, 자동 삭제를 명시했다.

decisions.decision: 회계연도는 1월 1일부터 12월 31일까지이며 종료된 청구의 해당 회계연도 말일부터 7년이 지난 뒤 다음 삭제 주기에 만료 대상으로 삼는다.
decisions.reason: 사용자가 1번 달력연도와 정확한 만료 경계를 명시했다.

decisions.decision: 관리자만 필수 사유와 함께 청구 단위 legal hold를 설정·해제하며 연결된 모든 revision·첨부·감사 기록에 원자적으로 적용하고 해당 동작도 append-only로 감사 기록한다.
decisions.reason: 사용자가 1번과 hold 범위·원자성·감사를 명시했다.

decisions.decision: 보존 만료 자동 삭제를 매일 02:00 KST 실행하고 실패 항목은 미완료로 유지해 다음 실행에서 idempotent 재시도하며 결과를 관리자 감사 기록에 남긴다.
decisions.reason: 사용자가 1번과 작업 실패·재시도·감사 의미를 명시했다.

decisions.decision: 활성·보존 중 회사 전체 청구의 동일 영수증 파일 해시는 제출을 차단하고 동일 직원의 비용일·가맹점·금액·통화 일치는 사유 입력 후 제출 가능한 중복 의심으로 처리한다.
decisions.reason: 사용자가 1번과 권한·보존 수명주기 의미를 명시했다.

decisions.decision: 영수증과 환율 증빙은 PDF/JPG/PNG, 파일당 10MB로 제한하고 revision당 각각 10개와 5개까지 허용하며 서버 MIME·확장자·악성 파일 검사를 통과한 파일만 연결·다운로드한다.
decisions.reason: 사용자가 1번과 증빙별 개수 및 보안 검사 정책을 명시했다.

decisions.decision: 청구 1건은 비용 항목 1건만 나타내며 여러 영수증은 동일 비용의 증빙으로만 사용하고 다른 거래는 별도 청구로 작성한다.
decisions.reason: 사용자가 1번 단일 비용 구조를 선택했다.

decisions.decision: v1 경비 정책 자동화는 관리자 관리형 활성 카테고리 목록으로 제한하고 각 제출 revision에 카테고리 ID·이름 snapshot을 보존한다.
decisions.reason: 사용자가 1번과 한도·사전승인·예외 미자동화 및 비활성화 의미를 명시했다.

decisions.decision: 직원은 작성 중 청구를 수정·삭제하고 미결 제출 청구를 철회할 수 있다. 철회는 종료이며 승인 확정 revision은 잠겨 취소할 수 없고 지급 흐름으로 이동한다.
decisions.reason: 사용자가 1번과 철회·승인 잠금 의미를 명시했다.

decisions.decision: Employees may edit or delete drafts and withdraw pending submissions before a manager decision. A manager may revoke their own approval only before Finance moves the claim to Scheduled for payment; revocation requires a reason and returns the same revision to Submitted for review. Revocation is forbidden at or after Scheduled.
decisions.reason: The user explicitly changed the prior irreversible-approval rule to permit bounded recovery.

decisions.decision: For an error discovered at or after Scheduled and before Payment completed, Finance puts the claim on Payment hold with a mandatory reason. Only Admin may reopen it as Changes requested; the employee submits a new revision and the current direct manager approves again. Prior history is preserved, and possible external execution requires Finance verification before reopen.
decisions.reason: The user selected the controlled hold and reopen correction flow.

decisions.decision: Payment completed is immutable. Finance records any post-payment correction as a linked settlement adjustment of type Recovery or Additional payment with mandatory reason, amount, status, completion date, external reference, and explicit in-progress, failed, or completed outcome.
decisions.reason: The user selected a separate adjustment ledger instead of reverting actual payment history.

decisions.decision: Scheduled requires a date of today or later. Payment completed requires method, actual payment date, and a company-wide unique external reference. Method is Bank transfer, Corporate card settlement, Cash, or Other; Other requires description.
decisions.reason: The user selected option 1 and specified validations and method inventory.

decisions.decision: A Scheduled claim becomes Payment overdue at 00:00 KST the next day. The responsible Finance user receives one email and one in-app notification daily until completed, failed, or held; notification failure never mutates payment state and duplicate delivery is prevented.
decisions.reason: The user selected option 1 and specified timing, channels, stop conditions, and failure semantics.

decisions.decision: Approved claims enter a shared Finance queue. The atomic transition to Scheduled claims the acting Finance user as owner; stale competing transitions fail and return latest state. Admin may reassign with mandatory reason and audit previous/new owner and time.
decisions.reason: The user selected shared queue plus atomic self-claim and controlled reassignment.

decisions.decision: Actionable lifecycle events send both email and in-app notifications to the defined employee, manager, or shared Finance queue recipients. Deliveries are separate idempotent records and failure never rolls back business state.
decisions.reason: The user selected both channels and specified recipients and transaction separation.

decisions.decision: Failed notification deliveries retry at 1, 10, and 60 minutes, then become Permanent failure with an Admin in-app operations warning. Unique event key prevents duplicates and Admin may trigger one manual retry after reviewing reason.
decisions.reason: The user selected option 1 and specified permanent failure and manual recovery.

decisions.decision: Server drafts preserve text and linked-file metadata across re-login. Failed file bytes are discarded. Scan timeout retries at 30 seconds and 2 minutes while Scanning; unresolved scan fails and blocks submit while other draft data remains.
decisions.reason: The user selected server-side recovery with bounded scan retries and no retention of failed bytes.

decisions.decision: Drafts and linked attachments expire 90 days after last saved actual change, with email and in-app warning 7 days before. View-only access does not reset expiry. Automatic deletion audits draft ID and time.
decisions.reason: The user selected 90-day inactivity retention with warning and audited deletion.

decisions.decision: Draft auto-save uses 2-second debounce plus immediate save on field blur and file-link completion. UI shows Saving/Saved/Save failed, preserves browser input, provides exponential and manual retry, and warns before leaving with unsaved changes.
decisions.reason: The user selected option 1 and specified save triggers and failure behavior.

decisions.decision: Draft save retries at 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16 seconds then stops. Browser input remains for manual retry. New input creates a new generation, cancels older retries, and only latest snapshot may save.
decisions.reason: The user selected bounded exponential retry and latest-generation semantics.

decisions.decision: Expired drafts are deleted by the daily 02:00 KST retention job after eligibility recheck. Failed items remain undeleted, retry idempotently next run, and produce audit results.
decisions.reason: The user selected the shared daily retention schedule with safe retry semantics.

decisions.decision: Claims more than 90 days after expense date require late reason but may submit; manager sees late days and reason. Future expense date blocks. Calendar computation uses Asia/Seoul.
decisions.reason: The user selected option 2 and specified future-date and timezone validation.

decisions.decision: Role removal or account deactivation immediately invalidates all sessions and refresh tokens; next API request enforces latest authorization. Rejected in-progress mutations preserve editable draft input and show re-login guidance.
decisions.reason: The user selected immediate revocation with safe draft recovery.

decisions.decision: Invitation links expire seven days after issuance. A successful re-invite immediately invalidates the prior unused link. Activation is restricted to the invited email, links confer no authority on active or deactivated accounts, and issue, reissue, acceptance, and expiry are audited.
decisions.reason: The user selected a bounded, single-use invitation lifecycle with account-state protections and full auditability.

decisions.decision: An Admin may revoke an unaccepted invitation with a mandatory reason, immediately invalidating the link and auditing target email, actor, and time. Concurrent acceptance and revocation are atomic competing transitions: only the first commit succeeds and the other request returns latest state.
decisions.reason: The user selected immediate audited manual revocation and explicitly defined race handling.

decisions.decision: Changes requested may cycle through new revisions without a fixed limit until final rejection or employee withdrawal. Every revision and review is retained. A newly submitted revision invalidates incomplete review actions for older revisions, and approval targets the exact latest revision.
decisions.reason: The user selected an unlimited correction loop with strict revision concurrency safety.

decisions.decision: All mutations use optimistic concurrency/version checks and idempotency keys. A stale mutation is wholly rejected and returns latest state plus changed fields while preserving browser input. Replaying the same idempotency key returns the original result.
decisions.reason: The user selected a uniform no-partial-write conflict policy with safe user recovery and retry deduplication.

decisions.decision: Employees may read all revisions and review history of their own claim. Managers and Finance users with current processing authority may read all revisions and reviews of the in-scope claim. Attachment access and timeline masking remain enforced, and loss of authority immediately revokes historical access.
decisions.reason: The user selected complete authorized context with dynamic least-privilege revocation.

decisions.decision: A failed payment may return to Scheduled only after Finance creates an append-only verification concluding Not paid, with payment channel, masked account identifier, lookup period, prior external reference or lookup result, verifier, and time; evidence may be attached and all records link to the original claim.
decisions.reason: The user selected structured duplicate-payment prevention with durable evidence.

decisions.decision: Actual payment date uses Asia/Seoul and must fall from the latest valid manager approval that led to this payment through today, inclusive. Future and pre-approval dates are blocked, and every entry or correction is audited.
decisions.reason: The user selected a lifecycle-bounded payment date with reapproval-aware provenance.

decisions.decision: A completed claim may have multiple sequential settlement adjustments but at most one In progress adjustment. Display original payment, completed recovery total, completed additional-payment total, and net settled amount; failed and cancelled adjustments are excluded. Creation checks latest version and atomically enforces active uniqueness.
decisions.reason: The user selected repeatable corrections with serialized execution and deterministic totals.

decisions.decision: A failed settlement adjustment is never reactivated. Finance appends external-execution verification: Not executed closes it failed/cancelled and permits a new linked adjustment; Executed completes the existing adjustment with actual amount/date/reference; Unclear moves it to blocking Needs verification until resolved.
decisions.reason: The user selected immutable retries with explicit handling for uncertain external execution.

decisions.decision: v1 provides dedicated Admin web screens for invitations/revocation, accounts/multiple roles, direct managers, categories, legal holds, manager/Finance reassignment, full audit, and operational warnings. Organization charts, departments, cost centers, and automated amount policies are non-goals. Every Admin mutation uses latest-version validation and audit.
decisions.reason: The user selected a complete operational console without expanding into organization or policy automation.

decisions.decision: v1 claim amount is only the receipt's final paid total. Tax-base/VAT separation and deductibility assessment are out of scope. A foreign-currency claim converts the final total in original currency.
decisions.reason: The user selected a single gross-total amount model for v1.

decisions.decision: File download access is valid for five minutes and scoped to one user and file, reusable for range/retry. Every request rechecks login and latest role, relationship, and file authority. Raw tokens are not logged; issuance and successful/denied downloads are audited.
decisions.reason: The user selected short-lived streaming-compatible access with continuous authorization and token secrecy.

decisions.decision: From three elapsed Asia/Seoul calendar days after submission/resubmission, the assigned manager receives one daily email and in-app reminder. From seven elapsed days, Admin also sees an operational warning. No automatic delegation; reminders stop on decision, withdrawal, or reassignment and use existing idempotent retry policy.
decisions.reason: The user selected bounded visibility and escalation without changing approval authority.

decisions.decision: Email delivery service is the only v1 external integration. Accounting, payroll, bank, and SSO integrations are excluded. Users use invitation-email app-native accounts and Finance manually records external payment references. Export scope remains a separate open decision.
decisions.reason: The user selected a self-contained v1 with manual financial handoff and deferred export scope.

decisions.decision: Role-scoped lists support defined search, filters, and sorting. Finance and Admin only may export the current filtered result to CSV up to 10,000 rows, excluding attachments, tokens, and sensitive internal fields. Export generation/download are audited and export time rechecks latest authority.
decisions.reason: The user selected broad operational discovery with tightly controlled, bounded external transfer.

decisions.decision: Related-user timelines use a strict business-field allowlist; specified internal identity, authentication, network, storage, scan, concurrency, provider, legal-hold, and Admin-note fields are hidden. CSV uses the same or narrower allowlist, while authorized Admin raw-audit viewing remains available.
decisions.reason: The user selected positive-field authorization to prevent accidental internal-data exposure.

decisions.decision: Seed nine active categories with stable IDs: Transportation, Business lodging, Meals, Entertainment, Office supplies, Software/subscriptions, Education/books, Communications, and Other. Admin may rename/deactivate while history snapshots persist; zero active categories blocks new submission.
decisions.reason: The user selected an immediately usable default taxonomy with durable historical identity.

decisions.decision: Committed manager reassignment creates email and in-app deliveries for previous manager, new manager, and related employee. Common 1/10/60-minute retries, permanent failure, Admin warning, and one manual retry apply. Delivery failure never rolls back reassignment.
decisions.reason: The user selected consistent delivery reliability while preserving authorization-state atomicity.

decisions.decision: v1 supports responsive current iOS Safari and Android Chrome. Employees can capture or select JPG/PNG/PDF under existing upload controls. Core Admin and Finance actions work on mobile, while bulk CSV recommends desktop. Native apps and offline authoring are non-goals.
decisions.reason: The user selected mobile web parity for core work without native/offline complexity.

rules.statement: 각 직원은 고정 직속 매니저 1명과 연결되며 제출 시 해당 매니저가 승인자로 결정된다.
직원은 자신의 매니저를 임의로 바꾸거나 청구 승인자를 선택할 수 없다.
직속 매니저가 미지정된 직원의 청구 제출을 차단하고 관리자에게 문의하라는 안내를 표시한다.
매니저는 검토 결과로 승인, 수정 요청, 최종 반려 중 하나를 선택한다.
수정 요청에는 매니저 코멘트가 필수이며 직원은 동일 청구의 새 revision을 만들어 수정·재제출한다.
최종 반려에는 매니저 코멘트가 필수이고 해당 청구는 종료되며 같은 비용을 다시 청구하려면 새 청구를 만들어야 한다.
승인된 청구의 지급 상태는 지급 대기에서 지급 예정으로, 이후 지급 완료 또는 지급 실패로 수동 전환한다.
지급 완료 전환에는 외부 지급 참조번호와 지급일이 필수이고 지급 실패 전환에는 실패 사유가 필수다.
재무 담당자는 중복 지급이 아님을 확인한 뒤 지급 실패 청구를 지급 예정으로 다시 전환할 수 있다.
청구 제출에는 비용 발생일, 가맹점/지급처, 금액, 통화, 비용 카테고리, 업무 목적, 영수증이 모두 필수다.
회사 기준 통화는 KRW이며 외화 비용은 원통화 금액·통화와 직원이 청구하는 KRW 환산액을 함께 기록한다.
외화 청구에는 직원이 직접 입력한 적용 환율과 KRW 환산액이 필수다.
외화 청구에는 카드 명세, 은행 환전 내역, 공식 환율 페이지 캡처 또는 PDF 중 하나를 환율 증빙으로 첨부해야 한다.
시스템은 원통화 금액×적용 환율과 입력 KRW 환산액의 차이가 정해진 반올림 허용오차 이내인지 검사하고, 매니저는 원통화 금액·환율·환산액·증빙이 맞지 않으면 수정 요청한다.
환율은 외화 1단위당 KRW로 소수점 6자리까지 입력한다. 원통화 금액×환율 결과를 원 단위 사사오입하고 직원 입력 KRW 환산액은 계산값 ±1원까지만 허용하며 범위 밖이면 제출을 차단한다.
직원은 자기 청구만, 매니저는 현재 자신에게 제출·재제출된 청구만, 재무 담당자는 매니저 승인 후 지급 대상이 된 청구만 조회한다.
관리자는 운영 목적으로 회사 전체 청구를 조회할 수 있다.
영수증과 환율 증빙의 조회·다운로드는 청구 조회 권한과 동일하며 파일 접근마다 재인증·권한 확인되는 짧은 수명 접근만 발급한다.
관리자만 이메일 초대를 발급할 수 있고 초대받은 이메일 주소로만 계정을 활성화할 수 있다.
공개 회원가입은 제공하지 않는다.
한 사용자에게 직원, 매니저, 재무 담당자, 관리자 역할을 둘 이상 부여할 수 있다.
서버는 모든 동작에서 필요한 역할과 대상 관계를 검사하며 청구자와 승인자가 같은 자기 승인을 금지한다.
관리자만 직원의 고정 직속 매니저를 지정하거나 변경할 수 있다.
제출 또는 재제출된 각 청구 revision은 그 시점의 직속 매니저를 승인자로 고정하며 정상적인 매니저 변경 뒤에도 해당 매니저가 계속 처리한다.
매니저 변경 후 제출되는 새 청구와 다음 재제출 revision부터 새 매니저를 적용하고 변경 전후 매니저와 적용 경계를 감사 기록에 남긴다.
제출 당시 매니저가 비활성화되어 진행 중 revision을 처리할 수 없으면 관리자만 새 매니저에게 재배정할 수 있다.
재배정은 기존 검토 코멘트를 보존하고 미완료 승인 권한만 이전하며 이전·새 승인자, 사유, 시각을 감사 기록에 남긴다.
재배정 알림 실패는 완료된 승인 권한 재배정을 롤백하지 않는다.
생성, 수정, 제출, 검토 결과, 코멘트, 역할·매니저 변경, 지급 정보, 파일 업로드·교체·다운로드를 변경 전후 값, 수행자, 시각, 대상 revision과 함께 append-only로 기록한다.
관리자는 회사 전체의 원본 감사 기록을 조회할 수 있다.
관련 사용자는 자기 청구 화면에서 기존 조회 권한으로 볼 수 있는 처리 타임라인만 보며 민감 내부 필드와 다른 사용자 정보는 숨긴다.
지급 완료 또는 최종 반려된 회계연도를 기준으로 청구, 영수증·환율 증빙, 감사 기록을 7년 보관하며 관리자는 이 기간을 변경할 수 없다.
legal hold가 설정된 청구와 연결된 첨부·감사 기록은 보존 기간이 지나도 삭제하지 않고 hold 해제 후 다음 삭제 주기에 처리한다.
v1은 보존 기간이 만료되고 legal hold가 없는 자료를 자동 삭제 작업으로 처리한다.
자동 삭제 작업은 삭제 대상과 결과를 감사 기록에 남긴다.
회계연도는 매년 1월 1일부터 12월 31일까지로 고정하며 지급 완료 또는 최종 반려 청구는 해당 회계연도 말일부터 7년이 지난 뒤 다음 자동 삭제 주기에 대상이 된다.
관리자만 필수 사유를 입력해 청구 단위 legal hold를 설정하거나 해제할 수 있다.
legal hold 설정·해제는 해당 청구의 모든 revision, 영수증·환율 증빙, 감사 기록에 원자적으로 적용되어 일부만 변경된 상태를 허용하지 않는다.
legal hold 설정과 해제는 수행자, 시각, 필수 사유, 대상 청구와 함께 append-only 감사 이벤트로 기록한다.
보존 만료 및 legal hold 해제 자료의 자동 삭제 작업은 매일 02:00 KST에 실행한다.
삭제 실패 항목은 삭제 완료로 표시하지 않고 다음 실행에서 같은 대상 ID에 대해 idempotent하게 재시도한다.
각 자동 삭제 실행의 성공·실패 건수와 대상 ID, 오류를 관리자용 append-only 감사 기록에 남긴다.
회사 전체의 활성 또는 보존 중 청구에서 동일 영수증 파일 해시가 발견되면 새 청구 제출을 차단한다.
동일 파일 해시 차단 시 기존 청구 ID는 그 청구를 조회할 권한이 있는 사용자에게만 표시하고 권한이 없으면 존재 정보를 노출하지 않는다.
같은 직원의 비용일·가맹점·금액·통화가 모두 일치하면 중복 의심 경고와 사유 입력을 요구하지만 제출은 허용하고 매니저 검토 화면에 강조한다.
보존 정책에 따라 최종 삭제된 자료의 파일 해시는 이후 중복 검사에 사용하지 않는다.
영수증은 PDF, JPG, PNG만 허용하고 파일당 최대 10MB, 청구 revision당 최대 10개로 제한한다.
환율 증빙은 PDF, JPG, PNG만 허용하고 파일당 최대 10MB, 청구 revision당 최대 5개로 제한한다.
서버는 업로드 파일의 실제 MIME 유형과 확장자가 모두 허용 목록과 일치하는지 검사한다.
악성 파일 검사를 통과하기 전에는 어떤 역할도 파일을 다운로드할 수 없다.
MIME·확장자 또는 악성 파일 검사에 실패한 파일은 청구 revision에 연결하지 않는다.
청구 1건에는 비용 항목 1건만 포함한다. 여러 영수증은 동일 비용의 증빙으로만 연결하며 서로 다른 거래는 별도 청구로 작성한다.
관리자는 활성 비용 카테고리 목록을 생성·관리할 수 있고 직원은 새 청구에서 활성 카테고리만 선택할 수 있다.
v1은 카테고리별 금액 한도, 사전승인, 예외 승인을 자동 검증하지 않는다.
각 제출·재제출 revision은 제출 당시 선택한 카테고리 ID와 이름 snapshot을 보존한다.
이미 사용된 카테고리를 비활성화해도 과거 revision의 snapshot은 유지하고 새 청구에서는 선택할 수 없다.
직원은 작성 중 청구를 수정하거나 삭제할 수 있다.
제출 후 직원의 직접 수정은 금지하며 매니저가 승인·수정 요청·최종 반려를 확정하기 전까지만 직원이 철회할 수 있다.
철회된 청구는 종료 상태이고 같은 비용을 다시 청구하려면 새 청구를 작성한다.
매니저 승인 확정 시 해당 revision을 잠그고 매니저의 승인 철회를 금지하며 청구를 재무 지급 흐름으로 이동한다.

Before Finance changes a claim to Scheduled, the approving manager may revoke only their own approval with a mandatory reason. Revocation returns the same revision to Submitted for review. Revocation is forbidden at or after Scheduled.
At or after Scheduled and before Payment completed, Finance may place a claim on Payment hold only with a mandatory reason.
Payment completed is never reverted or overwritten by a later correction.
Finance creates a separate linked settlement adjustment with a mandatory reason and type Recovery or Additional payment.
Each settlement adjustment records amount, in-progress/failed/completed result, completion date when completed, external reference number, and links to the original claim and payment.
The original Payment completed audit event remains append-only and unchanged when settlement adjustments are created or updated.
Only Admin may reopen a Payment-hold claim as Changes requested; the employee then submits a new revision and the current direct manager must approve again.
All prior approval, approval-revocation, and Scheduled history remains append-only through the correction flow.
If external payment may already have executed, Admin reopening is blocked until Finance records duplicate-payment or recovery verification.
Scheduled requires a scheduled payment date that is today or in the future.
Payment completed requires payment method, actual payment date, and a company-wide unique external payment reference number.
Payment method is one of Bank transfer, Corporate card settlement, Cash, or Other.
Payment method Other requires a non-empty description.
A duplicate external payment reference number within the company blocks Payment completed.
At 00:00 KST on the day after scheduled date, an unresolved Scheduled claim is marked Payment overdue.
While overdue, the responsible Finance user receives at most one email and one in-app notification per day.
Overdue notifications stop when the claim becomes Payment completed, Payment failed, or Payment hold.
Notification failure does not change payment state, and delivery uses a per-claim per-channel per-day idempotency key to prevent duplicates.
After manager approval, the claim appears unassigned in the shared Finance queue.
The transition to Scheduled atomically assigns the acting Finance user as responsible owner.
If another Finance owner already claimed the item, a stale Scheduled transition fails without mutation and returns latest state.
Admin may reassign responsible Finance only with mandatory reason and must audit previous owner, new owner, and timestamp.
Employee receives email and in-app notifications for Changes requested, Final rejected, Approved, Scheduled, Payment completed, Payment failed, Payment hold, and settlement-adjustment result.
Manager receives email and in-app notifications for new submission, resubmission, and approval-revocation result.
The shared Finance queue receives email and in-app notifications for newly approved claims.
Notification delivery is stored separately from the business transaction with an idempotency key; delivery failure never rolls back business state.
After initial delivery failure, automatically retry at 1, 10, and 60 minutes for at most three retries.
If all automatic retries fail, mark delivery Permanent failure and expose it in Admin in-app operations warnings.
A delivery event unique key deduplicates initial, automatic retry, and manual retry sends.
After reviewing failure reason, Admin may trigger at most one manual retry for a Permanent failure delivery.
Server draft stores text and metadata for successfully linked files and restores them after re-login.
Transfer-failed and scan-failed file bytes are not linked or retained and require user re-upload.
A scan timeout retries automatically after 30 seconds and then after 2 minutes while the file displays Scanning.
If scan remains indeterminate after two retries, mark file failed, discard its bytes, and block submission until re-upload succeeds.
A failed attachment never deletes or corrupts the rest of the server draft.
A server draft and linked attachments expire 90 days after its last saved actual change.
Seven days before draft expiry, send employee one email and one in-app notification.
Saving an actual draft change resets the 90-day clock; viewing without change does not.
Expired-draft deletion records target draft ID and deletion timestamp in append-only audit.
Auto-save draft after two seconds without further input and immediately on field blur or successful file-link completion.
Display Saving, Saved, and Save failed states tied to the latest draft mutation.
On save failure preserve current browser input, retry with exponential backoff, and provide manual retry.
Warn before page navigation or close whenever current browser changes are not confirmed saved by the server.
Only a confirmed server save of an actual change resets the draft retention clock.
Draft save auto-retries after 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16 seconds and stops after five attempts.
After automatic retries stop, preserve browser input and allow manual retry only.
New user input increments save generation and cancels pending retries from all older generations.
The server accepts only the latest draft snapshot generation and rejects stale generation writes.
Expired-draft deletion executes daily at 02:00 KST in the retention deletion job.
At execution, delete only drafts that still satisfy the 90-day expiry condition.
A failed draft deletion remains undeleted and retries idempotently in the next daily run.
Each draft-deletion run records target draft ID and success or error result in append-only audit.
Compute expense age and future-date validation using Asia/Seoul calendar dates.
If expense date is more than 90 days before submission date, require a non-empty late reason but allow submit.
Manager review highlights computed late-day count and employee late reason.
An expense date later than the current Asia/Seoul date blocks submission.
Saving role removal or account deactivation immediately invalidates all active sessions and refresh tokens for that user.
Every API request checks latest roles, active status, and target relationship on the server.
An in-progress save or transition after revocation is rejected without business-state mutation and displays permission error plus re-login guidance.
When permission is revoked during editable draft work, preserve current browser input for recovery after authorized re-login.
An invitation link expires exactly seven days after issuance.
Successful reissue atomically invalidates every prior unused invitation link for that invitation target.
Only the invited email may activate the account; an invitation link grants no authority to an already active or deactivated account.
Invitation issue, reissue, acceptance, and expiry are append-only audit events.
Only an Admin may revoke an unaccepted invitation, and the revocation immediately invalidates its link.
Invitation revocation requires a reason and append-only audit data for target email, actor, and timestamp.
Invitation acceptance and revocation are atomic competing state transitions; only the first committed transition succeeds.
A losing concurrent acceptance or revocation request makes no mutation and returns the invitation's latest committed state.
A changes-requested claim may be resubmitted as a new revision without a fixed count limit until final rejection or employee withdrawal.
Every claim revision and its review history is retained immutably under the claim.
Submission of a new revision makes every incomplete review action targeting an older revision stale and non-mutating.
A manager decision must target the claim's exact latest submitted revision and include its revision identity/version in the server transition guard.
Every state or data mutation must include and validate the target's expected version.
A stale mutation is atomic no-op: it saves and transitions nothing, then returns latest state and the fields changed since the caller's version.
On a stale editable-form response, preserve the caller's unsaved browser values so the user can compare them with latest server fields and retry.
Replaying a mutation with the same idempotency key returns its original committed or rejected result without performing the mutation again.
An employee may read every revision and review history of their own claim.
A manager or Finance user with current processing authority may read every revision and review history of that in-scope claim in read-only mode.
Historical attachments retain the same least-privilege short-lived download checks and historical timelines apply internal-field masking.
Loss of current role or relationship authority immediately revokes access to every previously visible revision, review, and attachment.
Before retrying a failed payment, Finance must record payment channel, masked account identifier, lookup period, and prior external reference or lookup result.
The duplicate-payment verification must record conclusion, verifier, and timestamp; only conclusion Not paid permits Payment failed to Scheduled.
Duplicate-payment verification records and any supporting evidence are append-only and linked to the original claim.
Supporting verification evidence is optional but, when attached, follows existing malware scan, authorization, short-lived download, audit, retention, and legal-hold rules.
Actual payment date is an Asia/Seoul calendar date no earlier than the latest valid manager approval that led to the payment and no later than today.
If a claim is reopened and reapproved, the lower bound for actual payment date is the latest valid reapproval that led to the current payment path.
Every actual payment date entry and correction records append-only before/after values, actor, timestamp, and target revision/payment.
A completed claim may have multiple settlement adjustments sequentially, but no more than one adjustment may be In progress at any time.
Adjustment creation validates the claim's latest version and atomically enforces the per-claim unique In-progress constraint.
Net settled amount equals original payment amount minus completed recovery total plus completed additional-payment total.
Failed and cancelled adjustments remain in history but are excluded from recovery, additional-payment, and net-settled totals.
A failed settlement adjustment can never transition back to In progress.
Finance must append an external-execution verification before resolving a failed or uncertain adjustment.
A Not executed conclusion closes the old adjustment as failed/cancelled and permits a new adjustment that references the old adjustment.
An Executed conclusion completes the existing adjustment only with actual amount, completion date, and company-unique external reference.
An Unclear conclusion moves the adjustment to Needs verification; this state is not In progress but blocks creation of any new adjustment until resolved.
Dedicated Admin UI covers invitation/revocation, accounts and multiple roles, direct managers, and expense categories.
Dedicated Admin UI covers legal holds, manager and Finance reassignment, full audit records, and operational warnings.
Every Admin mutation validates expected latest version and follows global atomic stale-conflict behavior.
Every Admin mutation writes append-only before/after values, actor, time, target, and reason where required.
Organization charts, departments, cost centers, and automated amount-policy enforcement are outside v1 scope.
The claim amount equals the receipt's final paid total; v1 has no tax-base, VAT-separated, or deductibility fields.
For foreign-currency receipts, original amount is the final paid total in original currency and is the multiplicand for KRW conversion.
Tax-base/VAT separation and VAT deductibility assessment are explicit v1 non-goals.
A file download access token expires five minutes after issuance and is scoped to exactly one user and one file.
An unexpired token may be reused for range requests and retries, but every request revalidates login, latest roles, relationships, and file authority.
Loss of any required authority immediately rejects download even if the access token has not expired.
Raw download token values must never be written to application, access, error, or audit logs.
Download-token issuance and every successful or denied download request create append-only audit events without the raw token.
Beginning after three elapsed Asia/Seoul calendar days from each submission/resubmission, send the assigned manager at most one reminder per day by email and in-app.
Beginning after seven elapsed Asia/Seoul calendar days, expose the unresolved review in Admin operational warnings.
A review decision, employee withdrawal, or manager reassignment terminates all reminder and escalation delivery for that pending review assignment.
Approval-delay reminders use existing delivery-event idempotency, retry schedule, permanent-failure warning, and manual retry policy.
Approval delay never delegates or transfers authority automatically; an unavailable manager uses only the existing Admin reassignment process.
Email delivery service is the only external service integration in v1.
Accounting, payroll, bank, and SSO integrations are explicit v1 non-goals.
Authentication uses an app-native account activated only through the invited email; no external identity provider is used in v1.
Finance manually records external payment reference data; no v1 integration creates or verifies it automatically.
Within current role scope, lists search claim ID, merchant, and employee name.
Lists filter by status, expense/submission date, category, currency, assignee, late flag, and duplicate flag, and sort by date, amount, or recent change.
Only Finance and Admin may create CSV exports, and each export contains the current filtered result with a maximum of 10,000 rows.
CSV exports exclude attachments, access tokens, and fields classified as sensitive internal timeline data.
Export generation and export download each revalidate latest role and scope; authority loss denies the operation.
CSV export generation and download create append-only audit events recording actor, scope/filter snapshot, row count, result, and time.

Related-user timelines expose only event type, business status, timestamp, revision, directly involved actor display name/role, employee inputs, manager comments, payment status/method/date, and masked external reference.

Related-user views hide internal user IDs/emails; authentication/session/token/version data; IP/device/network data; storage paths/file hashes; scan diagnostics; concurrency/idempotency internals; provider payloads/errors; legal-hold reasons; and Admin-only notes.
CSV output uses the related-user allowlist or a strict subset and may never widen field visibility.
Authorized Admin raw audit viewing remains distinct from timeline and CSV projections and retains existing full-audit access controls.

A new company space seeds CAT-001 Transportation, CAT-002 Business lodging, CAT-003 Meals, CAT-004 Entertainment, CAT-005 Office supplies, CAT-006 Software/subscriptions, CAT-007 Education/books, CAT-008 Communications, and CAT-009 Other as active.
Admin may rename or deactivate a category but can never change or reuse its stable category ID.
Every submitted revision preserves the selected category stable ID and name snapshot even after later rename/deactivation.
If the company has zero active categories, every new claim submission is blocked with Admin-contact guidance.
A committed manager reassignment creates one email and one in-app delivery for the previous manager, new manager, and related employee.
Each reassignment delivery uses common retries at 1, 10, and 60 minutes, then becomes permanent failure and raises an Admin operational warning.
After reviewing a permanent reassignment-delivery failure, Admin may trigger exactly one manual retry under the common policy.
No reassignment-notification delivery failure or retry outcome may revert or alter the already committed reassignment.
v1 responsive web supports current iOS Safari and Android Chrome for Employee, Manager, Finance, and Admin core workflows.
On mobile, Employee may upload receipt/evidence JPG, PNG, or PDF using camera capture or file selection.
Mobile capture/selection follows the same count, size, extension, actual MIME, malware scan, autosave, and recovery rules as desktop upload.
Finance and Admin bulk CSV actions remain available on mobile but display desktop-recommended guidance.
Native mobile applications and offline claim authoring are explicit v1 non-goals.

flows.mobile_path: Responsive form -> camera capture or file picker -> identical upload/scan/autosave/recovery -> submit; offline shows unavailable and preserves only already-saved server draft.
flows.category_path: Load active categories -> select stable ID/name -> snapshot on submission; if zero active, block submission and direct employee to Admin.
flows.download_path: Authorize -> issue 5-minute user/file token and audit -> each range/retry reauthorizes -> stream or deny/audit; never log raw token.
flows.amount_entry_path: Enter receipt final paid total; if foreign currency, use original-currency final total with rate to calculate claimed KRW; no VAT split/deductibility step.
flows.revision_history_access: Employee browses all own revisions/reviews read-only; each attachment request rechecks current authority and timeline fields are masked.
flows.concurrency_path: Submit mutation with expected version/idempotency key; stale returns latest state and changed fields without loss of browser input; retry uses a new key after reconciliation.
flows.revision_loop_path: Changes requested -> employee creates next revision -> submit latest revision; repeat without fixed cap until final rejection or withdrawal.
flows.revoked_session_path: Reject mutation, preserve browser draft input, show permission and re-login guidance.
flows.late_claim_path: Future date blocks; >90 days requires reason then submits.
flows.draft_deletion_path: Daily job rechecks expiry and deletes; failed stays intact for idempotent next run.
flows.autosave_retry_path: Five bounded exponential attempts for current generation; new edits cancel old generation; manual retry remains.
flows.autosave_path: Debounced/immediate save -> visible result; failure preserves input and retries; unsaved exit warns.
flows.draft_expiry_path: Warn at day 83 of inactivity by both channels; actual saved change resets; expire at day 90; audit deletion.
flows.draft_failure_recovery: Restore server draft after re-login; re-upload failed file; show Scanning during two retries; final indeterminate failure blocks submit only.
flows.notification_failure_recovery: Retry at 1m/10m/60m, then Admin warning and one manual retry.
flows.approval_revocation_policy: Employee withdrawal remains limited to before a manager decision. Manager approval revocation is a separate action governed by RULE-061.
flows.name: 업무비 청구 제출 및 재제출
flows.precondition: 직원에게 고정 직속 매니저가 지정되어 있고 모든 필수 청구 필드와 영수증이 입력되어 있다. 외화 청구는 적용 환율, KRW 환산액, 허용된 환율 증빙도 입력되어야 한다.
flows.happy_path: 새 청구를 제출하거나 수정 요청된 동일 청구의 새 revision을 제출한다. 외화 비용이면 외화 1단위당 KRW 환율을 소수점 6자리 이내로 입력하고, 원통화 금액×환율을 원 단위 사사오입한 값과 ±1원 이내인 KRW 환산액 및 환율 증빙을 기록한다.
flows.blocked_path: 매니저 미지정, 필수 필드 누락, 환율 증빙 누락 또는 계산값 대비 ±1원 허용오차 초과 시 제출을 차단한다. 매니저 미지정은 관리자 문의를 안내한다. 최종 반려된 청구는 수정·재제출할 수 없다.
flows.source: 사용자 최초 요청 및 UNK-001·UNK-004·UNK-006·UNK-009·UNK-034 답변

flows.mobile_path: Responsive queue/detail supports review, comments, approve/changes/final reject, and conflict recovery on current mobile browsers.
flows.reassignment_notification_path: Commit reassignment -> create dual-channel deliveries for old/new manager and employee -> common retry/warning/manual retry; authority remains committed.
flows.approval_delay_path: Pending review -> elapsed day 3 daily dual-channel manager reminder -> elapsed day 7 Admin warning -> decision/withdrawal/reassignment stops; no auto delegation.
flows.download_path: Authorize manager relationship -> issue scoped token -> recheck current relationship and file access on every request -> stream or deny/audit.
flows.revision_history_access: Authorized manager browses all revisions/reviews read-only; relationship loss immediately denies history and attachment access.
flows.concurrency_path: Review mutation with expected version/idempotency key; stale is a complete no-op and refreshes latest state/diff; identical-key replay returns original result.
flows.revision_guard_path: Review exact latest submitted revision; reject stale action if a newer revision committed and return latest revision/state.
flows.revoked_session_path: Reject review transition using latest role/relationship and show re-login guidance.
flows.late_claim_review: Review sees highlighted late days and reason.
flows.notification_failure_recovery: Retry at 1m/10m/60m, then Admin warning and one manual retry.
flows.post_schedule_correction: Admin reopens Payment hold as Changes requested; employee creates a new revision; current direct manager re-reviews it.
flows.approval_revocation_policy: The approving manager may revoke with a mandatory reason before Scheduled; the same revision returns to Submitted and is reviewed again.
flows.name: 청구 검토 및 승인·수정 요청·최종 반려
flows.entry: 각 제출·재제출 revision은 제출 시점의 고정 직속 매니저 승인 대기열로 들어가고 정상적인 매니저 변경 후에도 그 매니저가 계속 처리한다.
flows.review_scope: 외화 청구는 원통화 금액, 외화 1단위당 KRW 환율, 원 단위 사사오입 계산값, ±1원 이내 KRW 환산액, 환율 증빙을 함께 검토한다.
flows.alternative_path: 외화 환산 정보나 증빙이 맞지 않으면 수정 요청한다. 다음 재제출 revision은 그 시점의 새 매니저에게 라우팅될 수 있다. 제출 당시 매니저가 비활성화되면 관리자가 기존 코멘트를 보존한 채 미완료 승인 권한을 새 매니저에게 재배정하며 알림 실패는 재배정을 되돌리지 않는다.

flows.mobile_path: Responsive queue/detail supports core payment and adjustment state transitions; CSV action shows desktop recommendation.
flows.download_path: Authorize Finance scope -> issue scoped token -> recheck current processing/file access on every request -> stream or deny/audit.
flows.settlement_failure_resolution_path: Verify external execution append-only -> Not executed: close and create linked replacement; Executed: complete existing with actual fields; Unclear: Needs verification and block new creation.
flows.settlement_adjustment_sequence_path: Check latest claim version and no active adjustment -> atomically create In progress -> complete/fail/cancel -> permit next adjustment; recompute completed-only totals.
flows.actual_payment_date_path: Resolve latest valid approval leading to payment -> accept Asia/Seoul date within approval..today -> audit entry/correction; otherwise block.
flows.failed_payment_retry_path: Payment failed -> record structured append-only duplicate check and optional evidence -> only Not paid conclusion -> Scheduled; otherwise remain failed.
flows.revision_history_access: Authorized Finance user browses all revisions/reviews read-only; scope loss immediately denies history and attachment access.
flows.concurrency_path: Payment mutation with expected version/idempotency key; stale is a complete no-op and refreshes latest state/diff; identical-key replay returns original result.
flows.revoked_session_path: Reject payment mutation using latest role/relationship and show re-login guidance.
flows.notification_failure_recovery: Retry at 1m/10m/60m, then Admin warning and one manual retry.
flows.finance_claim_path: Shared queue -> atomic Scheduled plus self-assignment; stale competing claim fails and refreshes latest; Admin may reasoned-reassign.
flows.overdue_path: Next-day 00:00 KST marks overdue; notify responsible Finance daily by both channels; stop on completed, failed, or hold; failures do not mutate payment.
flows.scheduled_and_completed_fields: Scheduled requires today-or-future date. Completed requires method, actual date, and company-unique external reference; Other method requires description.
flows.post_payment_adjustment: Finance creates linked Recovery or Additional payment adjustment, records in-progress or failed states, and completes it with amount, completion date, result, and external reference.
flows.post_schedule_correction: Finance sets Payment hold with reason. If external execution is possible, Finance records duplicate/recovery verification before Admin can reopen.
flows.approval_revocation_policy: Changing a claim to Scheduled closes the manager approval-revocation window.
flows.name: 수동 지급 상태 관리
flows.precondition: 재무 담당자는 매니저 승인 후 지급 대상이 된 청구만 조회·처리한다.
flows.happy_path: 승인된 청구가 지급 대기가 되고 재무 담당자가 지급 예정, 지급 완료로 전환하며 완료 시 지급일과 외부 지급 참조번호를 기록한다.
flows.failure_path: 지급 실패 시 사유를 기록한다. 재무 담당자가 중복 지급이 아님을 확인한 뒤 지급 예정으로 되돌려 재시도한다.
flows.attachment_access: 청구 조회 권한과 동일하며 재인증·권한 확인되는 짧은 수명 접근만 허용
flows.source: 사용자 최초 요청 및 UNK-015·UNK-019 답변

states.category_submission_guard: Submission resolves selected category as currently active and snapshots ID/name atomically; zero active or selected inactive is rejected.
states.approval_delay_semantics: Reminder/escalation are derived from pending assignment and submission timestamp; decision, withdrawal, or reassignment clears the old assignment's derived state.
states.admin_mutation_semantics: Admin targets have versioned state; every mutation is atomic, stale-safe, idempotent, and produces append-only audit provenance.
states.settlement_failure_transitions: Failed never returns to In progress; verification yields failed/cancelled plus linked replacement eligibility, completed, or Needs verification; Needs verification blocks new adjustment.
states.settlement_adjustment_sequence_semantics: Per claim: many historical adjustments, at most one In progress; completed affects totals, failed/cancelled remains historical and contributes zero.
states.actual_payment_date_semantics: Payment completed transition validates latest payment-leading approval date <= actual payment date <= current Asia/Seoul date.
states.failed_payment_retry_guard: Payment failed remains unchanged unless a linked current verification concludes Not paid; then Finance may atomically transition it to Scheduled.
states.global_concurrency_semantics: All mutations compare expected version atomically; mismatch is no-op with latest state/diff, and identical idempotency-key replay returns original result.
states.revision_transition_semantics: Changes requested permits next revision repeatedly; final rejection and employee withdrawal terminate the claim; only latest submitted revision accepts a review transition.
states.draft_deletion_failure_state: Expired but undeleted remains retriable and is not marked deleted.
states.autosave_generation_semantics: Only latest generation can become Saved; older in-flight retries are cancelled or rejected as stale.
states.autosave_state_semantics: Latest server-confirmed mutation determines Saved and retention reset; browser-only mutation remains unsaved.
states.draft_expiry_semantics: last_actual_change_saved_at controls expiry; viewed_at does not.
states.attachment_scan_transition: timeout -> Scanning retry at 30s -> retry at 2m -> Linked on pass or Failed/discarded on indeterminate/fail.
states.notification_side_effect: State commits independently before idempotent delivery records are processed; delivery failure never reverts state.
states.finance_owner_transition: Unassigned Payment pending -> Scheduled plus responsible Finance owner in one atomic mutation.
states.overdue_state_semantics: Payment overdue is a derived marker on unresolved Scheduled, cleared by completed, failed, or hold.
states.payment_transition_guards: Payment pending -> Scheduled requires today-or-future date. Scheduled -> Payment completed requires method, actual date, and unique reference; Other requires description.
states.post_schedule_correction_transition: Scheduled -> Payment hold by Finance(reason) -> Changes requested by Admin(after required verification) -> new revision Submitted -> current manager approval.
states.approval_revocation_transition: Approved/Payment pending -> Submitted on approving manager revocation with reason; allowed only before Scheduled. Scheduled and later states cannot transition this way.

acceptance_criteria.mobile_expectation: Current iOS Safari/Android Chrome can capture/select each allowed format and complete valid submission; all desktop upload limits/failures/recovery match; offline authoring is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria.reassignment_notification_expectation: Related employee gets idempotent dual-channel delivery; all failures leave new manager assignment effective.
acceptance_criteria.category_expectation: All nine seeds are selectable initially; renamed/deactivated history remains accurate; zero active or stale inactive selection blocks submit.
acceptance_criteria.timeline_masking_expectation: Every rendered field belongs to the allowlist, external reference is masked, and all hidden classes remain absent from API and UI payloads.
acceptance_criteria.list_expectation: Search/filter/sort never returns claims outside Employee ownership; CSV action is absent/forbidden.
acceptance_criteria.download_expectation: Valid scoped range/retry succeeds within five minutes only while current authority remains; expiry/loss denies and all outcomes audit without raw token.
acceptance_criteria.tax_amount_expectation: Submission uses final receipt total; foreign conversion uses original-currency final total, and no tax split or deductibility input is requested or persisted.
acceptance_criteria.revision_visibility_expectation: Employee sees every own revision/review read-only, but hidden audit fields remain masked and each attachment download reauthorizes.
acceptance_criteria.concurrency_expectation: A stale edit writes nothing, returns latest state and field diff, preserves browser input, and exact idempotency-key replay returns the original result.
acceptance_criteria.revision_loop_expectation: Any number of changes-requested cycles may create sequential new revisions before termination, with all prior content and reviews retained.
acceptance_criteria.invitation_revocation_expectation: If acceptance loses an atomic race to Admin revocation, activation fails without mutation and displays the latest revoked state.
acceptance_criteria.invitation_expectation: A link works only for the invited email before seven-day expiry; successful reissue invalidates the old unused link and active/deactivated accounts gain no authority.
acceptance_criteria.late_claim_expectation: Future date blocks; day 91+ requires reason; valid late claim submits.
acceptance_criteria.draft_deletion_expectation: Only still-expired drafts delete at daily run; failures remain available and retry once per next run with audited result.
acceptance_criteria.autosave_retry_expectation: Older generation never overwrites newer input; five delays occur as specified and input remains for manual retry.
acceptance_criteria.autosave_expectation: Save triggers and UI state match latest mutation; failed saves retain browser input and navigation warns until server confirmation.
acceptance_criteria.draft_retention_expectation: Actual saved change extends expiry to 90 days, viewing does not, both warnings send 7 days prior, and deletion audits ID/time.
acceptance_criteria.draft_recovery_expectation: Re-login restores text and linked metadata; failed bytes are absent; unresolved scan blocks submit without losing other draft data.
acceptance_criteria.notification_expectation: Employee actionable events create one email and one in-app delivery record without changing committed claim state on failure.
acceptance_criteria.payment_hold_expectation: A reopened held claim requires the employee to submit a new revision.
acceptance_criteria.approval_revocation_expectation: A revoked approval returns the employee's same revision to Submitted; it does not create a new revision.
acceptance_criteria.statement: 고정 직속 매니저가 지정된 직원이 비용 발생일, 가맹점/지급처, 금액, 통화, 비용 카테고리, 업무 목적, 영수증을 모두 입력해야 청구를 제출할 수 있다. 외화 비용은 원통화 금액·통화, 외화 1단위당 KRW 환율(소수점 최대 6자리), 청구 KRW 환산액과 허용된 환율 증빙도 필수다. 시스템은 원통화 금액×환율을 원 단위 사사오입하고 입력 KRW액이 계산값 ±1원을 벗어나면 제출을 차단한다. 제출된 청구는 해당 매니저에게 라우팅되고, 수정 요청된 청구는 동일 청구의 새 revision으로 수정·재제출되며, 최종 반려된 청구는 재제출할 수 없다. 매니저 미지정 직원은 제출이 차단되고 관리자 문의 안내를 본다.
acceptance_criteria.source: 사용자 최초 요청 및 UNK-001·UNK-004·UNK-006·UNK-009·UNK-034 답변

acceptance_criteria.mobile_expectation: Manager can complete every core review outcome and stale-conflict recovery on current mobile browsers.
acceptance_criteria.reassignment_notification_expectation: Old/new managers each get dual-channel delivery with common retries; failures never restore old approval authority.
acceptance_criteria.timeline_masking_expectation: Manager timeline includes intended comments/business context but no hidden-class field in API or UI payloads.
acceptance_criteria.list_expectation: Search/filter/sort never returns claims outside current manager scope; CSV action is absent/forbidden.
acceptance_criteria.approval_delay_expectation: No reminder before day 3; at most one dual-channel event per eligible day; stop conditions halt future delivery; retries follow existing policy.
acceptance_criteria.download_expectation: Unexpired manager token is immediately denied after relationship loss; denial is audited without token disclosure.
acceptance_criteria.revision_visibility_expectation: Authorized manager sees all in-scope revisions/reviews; loss of relationship immediately makes prior history and attachments inaccessible.
acceptance_criteria.concurrency_expectation: A stale review action produces no partial decision and returns latest state/diff; duplicate-key replay cannot duplicate the review.
acceptance_criteria.revision_guard_expectation: A review action succeeds only for the exact latest submitted revision; an older in-flight action fails stale, mutates nothing, and returns latest state.
acceptance_criteria.invitation_revocation_expectation: A revoked manager invitation cannot activate or confer manager authority.
acceptance_criteria.invitation_expectation: Manager authorization derives from current active account roles and relationships, never possession of an invitation link.
acceptance_criteria.late_claim_expectation: Manager sees exact late day count and reason.
acceptance_criteria.notification_expectation: Manager and shared Finance events create idempotent email and in-app delivery records.
acceptance_criteria.payment_hold_expectation: The current direct manager must approve the new revision; prior history remains visible and immutable.
acceptance_criteria.approval_revocation_expectation: The approving manager can revoke only their own approval before Scheduled and only with a reason; the same revision returns to Submitted for re-review.
acceptance_criteria.statement: 각 제출·재제출 revision은 제출 시점의 고정 직속 매니저만 처리하며 정상적인 매니저 변경은 진행 중 revision의 승인자를 바꾸지 않는다. 제출 당시 매니저가 비활성화되면 관리자가 미완료 승인 권한만 새 매니저에게 재배정하고 기존 코멘트를 보존하며 이전·새 승인자, 사유, 시각을 감사 기록에 남긴다. 재배정 알림 실패는 권한 이전을 롤백하지 않는다. 매니저는 승인, 수정 요청, 최종 반려로 처리할 수 있고 수정 요청과 최종 반려는 코멘트가 필수다.

acceptance_criteria.mobile_expectation: Finance can complete every core state transition on current mobile browsers and sees desktop recommendation before bulk CSV.
acceptance_criteria.timeline_masking_expectation: Finance timeline/CSV include only allowlisted business fields, use masked reference, and exclude all hidden classes.
acceptance_criteria.list_expectation: Finance export matches current filtered authorized rows, rejects over 10,000 or lost authority, excludes prohibited fields, and audits generation/download.
acceptance_criteria.download_expectation: Unexpired Finance token is immediately denied after processing-scope loss; denial is audited without token disclosure.
acceptance_criteria.settlement_failure_resolution_expectatio: Failed cannot reactivate; each conclusion follows its exact branch, verification is immutable, and Unclear prevents any new adjustment until resolved.
acceptance_criteria.settlement_sequence_expectation: Concurrent or stale second creation cannot produce two active adjustments; completed-only formula is exact and failed/cancelled amounts never change totals.
acceptance_criteria.actual_payment_date_expectation: Future or pre-latest-valid-approval dates block completion; valid boundary dates succeed, and entry/correction audit preserves before/after provenance.
acceptance_criteria.failed_payment_retry_expectation: Rescheduling is blocked until every required verification field exists and conclusion is Not paid; the verification/evidence remain immutable and claim-linked after transition.
acceptance_criteria.revision_visibility_expectation: Authorized Finance sees all in-scope revisions/reviews; loss of processing scope immediately makes prior history and attachments inaccessible.
acceptance_criteria.concurrency_expectation: A stale payment action produces no partial transition and returns latest state/diff; duplicate-key replay cannot duplicate payment handling.
acceptance_criteria.invitation_revocation_expectation: Admin revocation requires a reason, audits target/actor/time, and a losing concurrent request sees latest state without overwriting it.
acceptance_criteria.invitation_expectation: Finance authorization derives from current active account roles, never possession of an invitation link; all invitation lifecycle events are auditable.
acceptance_criteria.notification_expectation: Payment and adjustment notification failures do not roll back payment or adjustment state.
acceptance_criteria.finance_owner_expectation: Only one Finance owner can atomically claim Scheduled; stale competitors see latest state; Admin reassignment requires reason and audits both owners and time.
acceptance_criteria.overdue_expectation: Each overdue day produces no more than one email and one in-app notification for responsible Finance; failures leave payment state unchanged and no alerts occur after completed, failed, or hold.
acceptance_criteria.payment_field_expectation: Past scheduled date, missing completed fields, missing Other description, or duplicate company external reference blocks the transition.
acceptance_criteria.settlement_adjustment_expectation: Post-payment corrections never alter Payment completed; a linked adjustment explicitly records type, amount, progress/failure/completion, completion date, result, and external reference while preserving original audit history.
acceptance_criteria.payment_hold_expectation: Finance reason is mandatory; possible external execution blocks Admin reopen until duplicate/recovery verification is recorded.
acceptance_criteria.approval_revocation_expectation: After Finance sets Scheduled, any manager approval-revocation attempt is rejected.
acceptance_criteria.statement: 재무 담당자는 매니저 승인 후 지급 대상 청구와 첨부만 조회할 수 있다. 첨부는 재인증·권한 확인되는 짧은 수명 접근으로만 다운로드된다. 승인된 청구를 지급 대기에서 지급 예정으로 전환하고, 지급일과 외부 지급 참조번호를 입력해야 지급 완료로 처리할 수 있다. 실패 사유를 입력하면 지급 실패로 처리되며 중복 지급이 아님을 확인한 뒤 지급 예정으로 재전환할 수 있다.
acceptance_criteria.source: 사용자 최초 요청 및 UNK-015·UNK-019 답변

acceptance_criteria.mobile_expectation: Admin can complete core management/warning actions on current mobile browsers and sees desktop recommendation before bulk CSV.
acceptance_criteria.reassignment_notification_expectation: Permanent failures appear as operational warnings, permit one audited manual retry, and never mutate the committed reassignment.
acceptance_criteria.category_expectation: Rename/deactivate retains immutable ID and prior snapshots, uses latest-version/audit policy, and warns when action leaves zero active categories.
acceptance_criteria.timeline_masking_expectation: Admin raw audit remains accessible only in its authorized view; Admin CSV cannot contain any field beyond the user-safe allowlist.
acceptance_criteria.list_expectation: Admin export matches current filtered authorized rows, rejects over 10,000 or lost authority, excludes prohibited fields, and audits generation/download.
acceptance_criteria.integration_boundary_expectation: Invite activation and native login work without SSO; no accounting/payroll/bank/SSO setup exists, and payment reference remains manual.
acceptance_criteria.approval_escalation_expectation: No Admin warning before day 7; unresolved review appears from day 7 and clears on decision, withdrawal, or reassignment without automatic delegation.
acceptance_criteria.statement: Admin can perform every in-scope administrative operation in dedicated screens, while excluded organization/policy controls are absent.
acceptance_criteria.admin_scope_expectation: Invitation/revocation, accounts/multiple roles, direct managers, categories, legal holds, both reassignment types, full audit, and warnings are available.
acceptance_criteria.concurrency_expectation: Stale Admin mutation is a complete no-op with latest-state diff; valid mutation commits once and creates audit provenance.
acceptance_criteria.non_goal_expectation: No organization chart, department, cost-center, or automated amount-policy action or data is present in v1.
